title: Tamil actor Sri found safe and receiving medical care after posting explicit content
summary: Tamil actor Sri (Shriram Natarajan) — who had been missing after posting explicit material on Instagram — has been located and is under professional medical care, director Lokesh Kanagaraj said. The director urged privacy, asked media to remove objectionable content, and said Sri is taking a break from social media. The actor, known for roles in Maanagaram and Vazhakku Enn 18/9, has reportedly faced health and personal challenges.
content:
Tamil actor Sri, also credited as Shriram Natarajan, who had been missing for several days after posting explicit material on Instagram, has been found and is receiving professional medical care.

Director Lokesh Kanagaraj, who worked with Sri on Maanagaram, provided the official health update. Fans and colleagues had grown increasingly worried when the actor shared graphic content online and then became unreachable. Attempts by friends, family and industry contacts to make contact were initially unsuccessful, prompting a social media outcry and calls for immediate help.

On behalf of Sri's family and close friends, Lokesh Kanagaraj released a statement that said: "We would like to inform all well-wishers, friends, and media that Actor Shriram is currently under professional medical care. He is taking a break from social media following the advice of his doctors." The director also stressed the need for privacy and urged people not to speculate or circulate unverified reports about Sri's condition.

The note asked media platforms to remove any objectionable content, including videos and interviews that misrepresent the situation. Lokesh further stated, "We do not endorse or support the statements made by certain individuals in the media, and we distance ourselves from such claims." The request underlined the family’s wish to manage the matter away from public sensationalism.

Sri's recent social media activity drew attention not only for adult-themed posts but also for visible physical changes, including significant weight loss and dyed blonde hair. Reports indicated he had been out of contact with his family for an extended period, which compounded concerns among well-wishers and industry peers.

The actor was last seen on screen in Irugapatru (2023), directed by Yuvaraj Shayalan. He began his career with Balaji Sakthivel’s Vazhakku Enn 18/9 and later delivered notable performances in Onaayum Aatukuttiyum, Son Papdi, Vil Ambu and Maanagaram. In recent years he had publicly expressed grievances about unpaid dues from past projects.

Fans and colleagues responded quickly on social media when Sri disappeared, tagging Lokesh Kanagaraj and others in hopes of securing information and assistance. With the latest statement confirming he is under medical care and stepping back from social platforms, those close to him have asked for respect, patience and the removal of sensational or misleading material while he recovers.
